CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cheongla_private.send_notification(people uuid[], kind text, target uuid, student uuid, label text, destination text, event_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 insert into public.cheongla_notifications(recipient_id,source_kind,source_id,student_id,title,route,event_key)
 select p.id,kind,target,student,label,destination,event_id
 from public.cheongla_profiles p where p.approval_status='approved' and p.membership_state='active'
 and p.id=any(people)
 on conflict(recipient_id,event_key) do nothing;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cheongla_private.enqueue_push_notification()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 insert into cheongla_private.push_deliveries(notification_id,subscription_id)
 select new.id,s.id from public.cheongla_push_subscriptions s
 where s.user_id=new.recipient_id and s.enabled on conflict do nothing;
 return new;
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cheongla_private.is_principal()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.cheongla_profiles where id=auth.uid() and approval_status='approved' and membership_state='active' and role in('owner','english_director','math_director'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cheongla_private.can_use_staff_journal()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.cheongla_profiles where id=auth.uid()and approval_status='approved'and membership_state='active'and role in('owner','english_director','math_director','manager','korean_teacher'));
$function$
